start.message:
Hi 👋

I'm a Clash of Clans clan war management bot.

🔹 Features:
• Auto monitoring for regular wars and CWL
• Start / end / 1-hour-left notifications
• In CWL, preparation notice only at league start
• Link Clash accounts to Telegram
• /war for regular wars and /cwl for CWL

Use /help for commands.
Use /setting to change language.

help.public: 🤖 War manager help Commands /war — Regular war status /cwl — Clan War League status /clan — Clan info /help — This help /setting — Language settings Accounts /link #TAG — Link a Clash account /unlink #TAG — Unlink an account /unlinkall — Unlink all your accounts /myaccounts — List linked accounts Note During CWL use /cwl. If you use /war while in CWL, the bot will guide you.
help.owner: 🤖 Bot help — Owner Public /war · /cwl · /clan · /help · /setting /link #TAG · /unlink #TAG · /unlinkall · /myaccounts Link others /link TELEGRAM_USER_ID #TAG /unlink TELEGRAM_USER_ID #TAG Owner tools /status — Technical status /testnotify — Test group notify /testlog — Test log channel /testw — Widget preview Note War/CWL notifications go to the group automatically.
